task.summary: Define and automate deterministic, privacy-safe aggregate metrics for public repository health.
acceptanceCriteria: Define reach, activation, feedback, contribution, and quality metrics with precise formulas and explicit non-goals.
Use the privacy-safe first-user feedback form that prohibits PHI, real patient data, secrets, private prompts, and production logs.
Add a standard-library GitHub collector that emits deterministic aggregate JSON without account identifiers or source text.
Fail closed on unsafe origins, redirects, bounded-response failures, API errors, and truncated or inconsistent pagination.
Add a scheduled and manual workflow with read-only permissions that uploads only the aggregate metrics snapshot.
Add regression tests, bilingual interpretation guidance, exactly one receipt, and independent AI review.

scope.description: Privacy-safe public GitHub metrics collector, deterministic regression tests, read-only scheduled artifact workflow, bilingual definitions, CI coverage, and project documentation.

tests.command: collect the same 30-day Actions metric for microsoft/vscode and verify the collector fails closed when GitHub reports more than 1,000 matching runs
verify read-only workflow permissions, pinned action commits, fixed artifact path, feedback form privacy controls, and bilingual metric formulas
git diff --check agent/v02-launch-kit and check all new files for whitespace errors
